analytics.name: Analytic 1807
analytics.guidance: Correlates (1) abnormal application or system resource resolution behavior (e.g., library loading, path resolution, or intent redirection), (2) execution of code or resources not aligned with the originating application’s package identity or expected runtime context, and (3) follow-on execution or network activity originating from the hijacked flow. The defender observes a causal chain where execution is redirected from an expected code path to an alternate resource or payload, resulting in execution under a trusted context but with untrusted origin.

tuning.description: Correlation window between abnormal resource loading and execution/network activity
Baseline of expected library/resource load paths per application
Trusted signing identities for application components
Applications allowed to dynamically load code or use external resources

log_sources.name: MobileEDR:telemetry
log_sources.channel: application launches or executes code where loaded library or component path does not match application package path or expected signing context

log_sources.name: MobileEDR:telemetry
log_sources.channel: application loads executable or library from external or writable directory (e.g., /sdcard/, app cache) prior to execution

log_sources.name: MobileEDR:telemetry
log_sources.channel: application execution triggered with unexpected parent context or via indirect invocation (intent redirection or component hijack)
